scriptScenes.title: Opening Title & Premise
scriptScenes.speaker: Voice-over
scriptScenes.dialogue: KONE's reported Q3 2026 sales growth came from Service and Modernization, across markets with different demand conditions. This scenario asks how experience in one market could inform a decision in another. The question is whether it can travel.
scriptScenes.headline: KONE Marketing OS | A day in the life of Anna, Growth Intelligence, 2027
scriptScenes.takeaway: Frame the session around growth decisions and cross-market intelligence, not technology architecture.

scriptScenes.title: Sense: The Portfolio View
scriptScenes.speaker: Anna Virtanen
scriptScenes.dialogue: Modernization is doing the work this year. Orders grew about 10% in the third quarter, and 65% of sales now come from Service and Modernization. The interesting question is not that modernization is growing. It is why one market is growing it faster than others with similar installed-base profiles.
scriptScenes.headline: Monday 1 February 2027, 09:00. Seven illustrative markets; modernization is the focus.
scriptScenes.takeaway: Compare 7 markets; identify Iberia's 40% activation rate relative to DACH as the prime opportunity.

scriptScenes.title: Diagnose: Why DACH, Not DACH's Campaign
scriptScenes.speaker: Anna Virtanen & Jonas Weber
scriptScenes.dialogue: The campaign is the newest thing we have, so it takes the credit. The evidence says the account list did the work: standard shafts converted 2.4x better, and technicians flagged 1,900 accounts. If that is right, it changes what we scale.
scriptScenes.headline: Activation is the leading hypothesis; creative contribution is secondary.
scriptScenes.takeaway: Decompose YoY growth (+27.3 pts): Account activation (+11.2) and shaft fit (+7.5) dwarf creative (+0.5).
scriptScenes.sceneTitle: Scene 3: Diagnose: Why DACH, Not DACH's Campaign

scriptScenes.title: Prioritise and Decide
scriptScenes.speaker: Anna Virtanen
scriptScenes.dialogue: Four markets have an installed base that looks like Germany's. One has the base, the partners and a modernization team that has already asked for help. Iberia scores 84 out of 100 on suitability, and clears our EUR 5m threshold.
scriptScenes.headline: Four candidates. One worth scaling now: Iberia (Priority 91/100, EUR 6.1m).
scriptScenes.takeaway: Clear leadership threshold separates actionable scaling from speculative broadcast.

scriptScenes.title: Replicate: What Travels
scriptScenes.speaker: Anna Virtanen
scriptScenes.dialogue: The playbook travels in five parts. Two of them need rebuilding locally: installation-year data has gaps, and the technician referral routine is not running. Replication is a handover with honest gaps, not a broadcast.
scriptScenes.headline: The critical screen: 'If KONE only knew what KONE knows'. Capability match & gap handover.
scriptScenes.takeaway: The focal screen of the leadership workshop: identify what travels vs what requires local market investment.

scriptScenes.title: The Recommendation Lands Locally
scriptScenes.act: Act 2: From Playbook to Launch in Iberia
scriptScenes.speaker: Marc Puig & Anna Virtanen
scriptScenes.dialogue: Marc: 'The German account list assumes every building has an installation year on file. Ours does not. Give me six weeks to fix the data and I will take 38 buildings, not the initial 120.' Anna: 'Take the 38. Validate each asset before quoting.'
scriptScenes.headline: One recommendation, one owner, one decision to make today: 38-building qualified cohort.
scriptScenes.takeaway: Respect local operational realities. Negotiate realistic scope over inflated vanity targets.

scriptScenes.title: Brief, Adapt, Launch
scriptScenes.act: Act 2: From Playbook to Launch in Iberia
scriptScenes.speaker: Marc Puig
scriptScenes.dialogue: The brief was not written from a blank page. It started from what worked in Germany. Create once, adapt everywhere shows up as 62% direct reuse, 31% adaptation, and only 7% net-new creation.
scriptScenes.headline: 38 buildings. 21 calendar days. Content Supply Chain: 62% Reuse, 31% Adapt, 7% New.
scriptScenes.takeaway: Content supply chain efficiency drives rapid time-to-market with 96/100 launch readiness.

scriptScenes.title: Measure, Learn, Close the Loop
scriptScenes.act: Act 2: From Playbook to Launch in Iberia
scriptScenes.speaker: Marc Puig & Anna Virtanen
scriptScenes.dialogue: 14 orders from 45 quotes: 31.1% conversion (+7.1 pts vs baseline). 6.4 average days on site. Referrals beat target at 112. But age verification lagged at 81.6%. And all 14 orders came from standard shafts.
scriptScenes.headline: Day-90 review: 31.1% conversion, EUR 341.6k booked value, 14/14 standard shafts.
scriptScenes.takeaway: Honest assessment of both wins and gaps feeds back as Learning Record LR-IB-01 into the OS.
scriptScenes.sceneTitle: Scene 8: Measure, Learn, Close the Loop

scriptScenes.title: Ingredients & Close for the Room
scriptScenes.act: Act 2: From Playbook to Launch in Iberia
scriptScenes.speaker: Workshop Facilitator & Petra (CMO)
scriptScenes.dialogue: This was not a smarter campaign. It was a test of a faster learning cycle. The intelligence was already in the service base and in the technician's notes. What we added was a route between them. Where should the next route be built?
scriptScenes.headline: KONE Marketing OS | Intelligence that travels. Three questions for the leadership room.
scriptScenes.takeaway: Transition to interactive workshop discussion around KONE's real-world signals and ownership.
scriptScenes.sceneTitle: Scene 9: Ingredients & Close for the Room

workshopQuestions.question: Where does KONE already hold the signal, and in how many separate systems?
workshopQuestions.context: In this fictional case, DACH account-age data was available before the decision. In reality, signals sit across Salesforce, SAP, Field Service Management, and connected IoT telemetry.
options: Fragmented across 4+ disconnected silos (Sales, Service, IoT, CX)
Partially unified in regional BI data warehouses
Accessible to sales reps but invisible to marketing planners
Rich asset telemetry exists but lacks commercial account linkage

workshopQuestions.question: What would stop the Iberia handover from happening today: the data, the capability, or the incentive to share?
workshopQuestions.context: Replication failed in past initiatives when global pushed finished campaigns without verifying local shaft geometry or technician readiness.
options: Incomplete installed-base telemetry & installation year data
Lack of service-to-sales handover routines and technician incentives
Misaligned KPIs between global marketing and local commercial P&Ls
Lengthy agency adaptation cycles and lack of modular ingredients

workshopQuestions.question: Which growth play gets a named owner for cross-market learning in 2027?
workshopQuestions.context: Marketing as a growth engine requires named leaders accountable for curating repeatable playbooks.
options: Customer Flow & Smart Access Urban Modernization
